note: Hand-authored inputs for tools/map-processor/build_map.py. Everything here is manual-approx.
geometryNote: dropObjectRegex: scene objects left out of the walk grid and the occluders. BalconyScaffolding_0_LightFixtureA.007 (x 20.97..25.25, y -53.67..-51.48, z 4.29..6.48) hangs under the floor of the Mid Top -> Vent doorway (Shell_6_VentRoomDoorFrameADU, x 20.79..24.72, y -52.03..-51.45; floors Floor_9_MidToVentRampE and Shell_6_VentRoomGroundADU both at z 6.50). Its sloped upper faces were sampled as floor and merged with the real floor into one layer whose mean height lay below the slab, so the slab itself counted as a body-height obstacle and every cell of the doorway (y -52.4..-51.9) was blocked: Mid Vent (232 walk cells at z 6.50) became an island. No triangle of any object lies in the doorway between 0.5 and 1.5 m above the floor (box x 22.0..23.6, y -52.4..-51.6, z 7.0..8.0: 0 triangles).
traversalsNote: Game uu. Ropes, ziplines, teleporters and jumps measured on the scene: a and b are the walk-grid cells at the two ends (they become roadmap nodes joined by a link in <map>.nav.json), zones the zone at each end. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

traversals.name: Vent pit rope to Mid Vent (south)
traversals.basis: Game metres. Rope under the ascender Kingdom_0_VertAscenderA.002 (x,y 32.71, -55.15; housing z 9.06..9.52). a = the walk cell at its foot, b = the nearest cell of the floor it reaches. The foot is the pit under the vent (152 walk cells at z 2.50, x 32.4..36.4, y -62.2..-52.2), entered by dropping from either side.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object position, the two walk cells, length 4.06 m); manual-approx (travel time = length / 6.75 m/s — speed assumed equal to the movement model's run speed (6.75 m/s): the game's rope / zipline speed was not measured; that the object is a usable rope: object name and game knowledge)
